decisions.reason: The source decision also concerns gross revenue, but the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing that matching must be evaluated with the applicable date range selected.
The date-range condition for comparing gross sales figures does not change which Juniper Tide data source is primary or which superseded source must be removed.
The clarification about date-range-dependent metric matching does not alter the retention policy for auxiliary Juniper Tide data sources.
